runtime: aem-boilerplate (scripts/aem.js vendored; scripts/scripts.js with decorateMain = decorateIcons > buildAutoBlocks > decorateSections > decorateBlocks > decorateButtons)
blockWrapperClass: <name>-wrapper on the block's parent div; <name>-container on the section; block gets .block + data-block-name + data-block-status
buttonization:
requires authored / around the single-link

; bare

links are NOT buttonized (a.title set from text); links containing skipped
fragmentScriptPolicy: blocks/fragment/fragment.js is the only cross-block import; loadFragment(path) fetches <path>.plain.html, runs decorateMain + loadSections; header/footer blocks load /nav and /footer through it (getMetadata('nav'|'footer') override)
fonts: scripts/scripts.js loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css in loadEager when innerWidth >= 900 (or sessionStorage fonts-loaded), always again in loadLazy; fonts.css declares PT Serif 400 + Source Sans Pro 200-900 (variable)
sections: decorateSections wraps default content in .default-content-wrapper; sections start display:none until loadSection; section-metadata folded by the pipeline
icons: :name: -> span.icon.icon-name ->
